senses.def: An item that grants the player an extra life in the game, staving off game over by one more try.
In a game with multiple players, an indicator or identifier of player 1.
ex: Before any player registers points, the PAC-MAN scoring table displays in white "1 UP" and "2 UP" where the scores will appear.

senses.def: An item that grants the player two extra lives in the game.
In a game with multiple players, an indicator or identifier of player 2.
ex: Before any player registers points, the PAC-MAN scoring table displays in white "1 UP" and "2 UP" where the scores will appear.

senses.def: A lemon-lime-flavored, non-caffeinated soft drink.
being or moving higher in position or greater in some value; being above a former position or level
ex: the anchor is up
the sun is up

senses.def: out of bed
ex: are they astir yet?
up by seven each morning

senses.def: getting higher or more vigorous
ex: it's an up market
an improving economy

senses.def: extending or moving toward a higher place
ex: the up staircase
a general upward movement of fish

senses.def: (usually followed by ‘on’ or ‘for’) in readiness
ex: he was up on his homework
had to be up for the game

senses.def: open
ex: the windows are up

senses.def: (used of computers) operating properly
ex: how soon will the computers be up?

senses.def: used up
ex: time is up

senses.def: spatially or metaphorically from a lower to a higher position
ex: look up!
the music surged up

senses.def: to a higher intensity
ex: he turned up the volume

senses.def: nearer to the speaker
ex: he walked up and grabbed my lapels

senses.def: to a more central or a more northerly place
ex: was transferred up to headquarters
up to Canada for a vacation

senses.def: to a later time
ex: they moved the meeting date up
from childhood upward

senses.def: raise
ex: up the ante

senses.def: Away from the surface of the Earth or other planet; in opposite direction to the downward pull of gravity.
ex: I looked up and saw the airplane overhead.
Shoots grow up and roots grow down.

senses.def: To or at a physically higher or more elevated position.
ex: All day we climbed up and up.
Lift the carpet up and look underneath.

senses.def: To an upright or erect position.
ex: sit up; stand up; get up out of bed

senses.def: To a higher level of some quantity or notional quantity, such as price, volume, pitch, happiness, etc.
ex: Gold has gone up with the uncertainty in the world markets.
Turn it up, I can barely hear it.

senses.def: To or towards what is considered the top of something, irrespective of whether this is presently physically higher.
ex: Go back up to the top of the page.
As I lay on my back, a pain shot up from my toes to my chest.

senses.def: To the north (as north is at the top of typical maps).
ex: I live in Florida, but I'm going up to New York to visit my family this weekend.

senses.def: Towards or at a central place, or any place that is visualised as ‘up’ by virtue of local features or local convention, or arbitrarily, irrespective of direction or elevation change.
ex: We travelled from Yorkshire up to London.
I'm going up to the other end of town.

senses.def: Towards the principal terminus, towards milepost zero.
To university, especially to Cambridge or Oxford.
ex: She's going up to read Classics this September.

senses.def: Against the wind or current.
Towards the source of a river, against the direction of flow.
ex: We started in London and rowed all the way up to Oxford.

senses.def: In a positive vertical direction.
To or in a position of equal advance or equality; not short of, back of, less advanced than, away from, etc.; usually followed by to or with.
ex: I was up to my chin in water.
A stranger came up and asked me for directions.

senses.def: Used as an aspect marker to indicate a completed action or state; thoroughly, completely.
ex: I will mix up the puzzle pieces.
Tear up the contract.

senses.def: To one's possession or consideration.
ex: I picked up some milk on the way home.
The committee will take up your request.

senses.def: Aside or away, so as no longer to be present or in use.
ex: to lay up riches; put up your weapons

senses.def: Relatively close to the batsman.
ex: The bowler pitched the ball up.

senses.def: Without additional ice.
ex: A Cosmopolitan is typically served up.

senses.def: Toward the top of.
ex: The cat climbed up the tree.
They walk up the steps.

senses.def: Toward the center, source, or main point of reference; toward the end at which something is attached.
ex: The information made its way up the chain of command to the general.
I felt something crawling up my arm.

senses.def: From south to north of.
ex: We sailed up the East Coast of England from Ipswich to South Shields.

senses.def: Further along (in any direction).
ex: Go up the street until you see the sign.

senses.def: From the mouth towards the source of (a river or waterway).
ex: He led an expedition up the Amazon.

senses.def: Of a person: having sex with.
ex: Phwoar, look at that bird. I'd love to be up her.

senses.def: At (a given place, especially one imagined to be higher or more distant from a central location).
ex: I'll see you later up the snooker club.

senses.def: Facing upwards.
ex: Turn the cloth over so that the patterned side is up.

senses.def: On or at a physically higher level.
ex: The flood waters are up again across large areas of the country.

senses.def: Headed or designated to go upward (as an escalator, stairway, elevator etc.) or toward (as a run-up).
ex: Where is the up escalator?

senses.def: Fitted or fixed at a high or relatively high position, especially on a wall or ceiling.
ex: All the notices are up now.
The Christmas decorations are up.

senses.def: Available to view or use; made public; posted.
ex: Is your new video up yet? I looked on the website, but I couldn't find it.

senses.def: Aloft.
ex: The kite is up!

senses.def: Raised; lifted.
ex: The castle drawbridge was up.
Don't go into the living room just now – I've got the carpet up.

senses.def: Of a river, in flood or at a high level.
Built, constructed.
ex: Are the new buildings up yet?

senses.def: Standing; upright.
ex: The audience were up and on their feet.

senses.def: Riding the horse; mounted.
Above the horizon, in the sky.
ex: It'll get warmer once the sun's up.

senses.def: Larger; greater in quantity, volume, value etc.
ex: Sales are up compared to last quarter.
My temperature is up this morning.

senses.def: Indicating a larger or higher quantity.
ex: The barometer is up, so fine weather should be on the way.

senses.def: Ahead; leading; winning.
ex: The home team were up by two goals at half-time.

senses.def: Finished, at an end.
ex: Time is up!
Her contract is up next month, so it's time to negotiate another one.

senses.def: In a good mood.
ex: I’m feeling up today.

senses.def: Willing; ready.
ex: If you are up for a trip, let’s go.

senses.def: Next in a sequence.
ex: Smith is up to bat.

senses.def: Happening; new; of concern. See also what's up, what's up with.
ex: What's up, bro?
What is up with that project at headquarters?

senses.def: Said of the higher-ranking pair in a two pair.
ex: AAKK = aces up
QQ33 = queens up

senses.def: Well-informed; current.
ex: I’m not up on the latest news. What’s going on?

senses.def: Functional; working.
ex: Is the server back up?

senses.def: Traveling towards a major terminus.
ex: The London train is on the up line.

senses.def: Chilled and served without ice; (often specifically) shaken with ice and then strained into a coupe for serving, leaving the ice behind.
ex: Would you like that drink up or on ice?

senses.def: Erect.
Well-known; renowned.
The direction opposed to the pull of gravity.
ex: Up is a good way to go.

senses.def: A positive thing, or a time or situation when things are going well.
ex: I hate almost everything about my job. The only up is that it's so close to home.

senses.def: An up quark.
An upstairs room of a two story house.
ex: She lives in a two-up two-down.

senses.def: To physically raise or lift.
ex: We upped anchor and sailed away.

senses.def: To increase the level or amount of.
ex: If we up the volume, we may be able to hear what he says.

senses.def: To promote.

ex: She was sitting there quietly, then all of a sudden she upped and left.

senses.def: To upload.
ex: 100 new apps and games have just been upped.
